mainTopic: The order of skinning and cutting up the קרבן תמיד, and which כהן carries each piece (משנה, מסכת תמיד)
overview: This amud continues the משנה that describes, step by step, how the כהן cut up the daily קרבן תמיד after it was slaughtered. He hangs the animal by a hole near the knee instead of breaking the leg, and skins it from the top down. He removes the head, the legs and the right hind leg, handing each piece to the כהן who won it in the lottery. He opens the body, puts the פדר fat over the cut neck, and sends the stomach and innards to be rinsed. Then he separates the organs from each other but leaves each in place, so it comes off with the piece it hangs from. The liver goes with the right flank, the windpipe, heart and lung with the גרה, and the spine and spleen with the left flank. The עוקץ comes with the tail, the finger of the liver and the kidneys, and the left hind leg is last. At the end, all the winning כהנים stand in a row, each holding his piece.

steps.title: Hanging the animal without breaking its leg
steps.stepSummary: The כהן does not break the leg to skin the animal. Instead he makes a hole near the knee and hangs the animal from it.
steps.simpleTranslation: He would not break the leg. Instead, he pokes a hole through the knee area and hangs the animal by it.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה begins describing how the כהן gets the קרבן תמיד ready for skinning: he hangs it up by a hole in the leg.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The usual way to skin an animal would involve breaking the leg. Here the משנה says the כהן avoided that. He pierced the leg near the knee and used that hole to hang the animal, so it could be skinned whole.

keyTerms.meaning: he pierces it, makes a hole in it

phrases.aramaic: לֹא הָיָה שׁוֹבֵר בּוֹ אֶת הָרֶגֶל,
phrases.english: He would not break the leg of the animal,
rather, he pierces it from within its knee,
and hangs the animal by it.

steps.triggerLanguage: לֹא הָיָה שׁוֹבֵר בּוֹ אֶת הָרֶגֶל
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The animal is hung for skinning by a hole pierced near the knee, without breaking the leg.

steps.title: Skinning down to the chest and removing the head and lower legs
steps.stepSummary: The כהן skins down to the chest. He cuts off the head and the lower legs and gives each to the כהן who won it. Then he finishes the skinning and cuts the heart to let out its blood.
steps.simpleTranslation: He skins going downward until he reaches the chest. At the chest, he cuts off the head and gives it to the כהן who won it. He cuts off the lower legs and gives them to the ones who won them. He finishes the skinning. He tears open the heart and lets out its blood.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה continues the procedure in order: partial skinning, removing the head and lower legs, finishing the skin, and draining the heart.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The skinning stops halfway, at the chest, so that the head and lower legs can be cut off first. Each part goes to a specific כהן who won the job of carrying it. Only after that is the הפשט finished and the heart's blood let out.
steps.confusionAlert: "The one who won it" means a כהן who won this specific job in the lottery. It does not mean he gets to keep the part.

phrases.english: He would skin, going downward,
until he reaches the chest.
Once he reached the chest, he cut off the head,
and gave it to the one who won it.
He cut off the lower legs,
and gave them to the one who won them.
He finished the skinning.

phrases.aramaic: קָרַע אֶת הַלֵּב וְהוֹצִיא אֶת דָּמוֹ.
phrases.english: He tore open the heart and let out its blood.

steps.triggerLanguage: הָיָה מַפְשִׁיט וְיוֹרֵד עַד שֶׁמַּגִּיעַ לֶחָזֶה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the procedure once the animal is hanging.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The head and lower legs are removed when the skinning reaches the chest. Then the skinning is finished and the heart is drained.

steps.title: Removing the forelegs and right hind leg, then opening the body
steps.stepSummary: The כהן cuts off the forelegs and the right hind leg, together with the two testicles. Then he tears the animal open so all its insides are exposed.
steps.simpleTranslation: He cuts off the front legs and gives them to the ones who won them. He goes up to the right leg, cuts it off, and gives it to the one who won it, with the two testicles along with it. He tears the animal open, and now the whole inside is exposed in front of him.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה continues taking the animal apart: the front legs, then the right hind leg, then opening the body.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Each limb again goes to the כהן who won it. The two testicles go along with the right leg. Tearing the body open exposes everything inside and prepares the next stage, removing the fats and innards.

phrases.english: He cut off the front legs,
and gave them to the one who won them.
He went up to the right leg and cut it off,
and gave it to the one who won it,
and the two testicles along with it.
He tore it open, and the whole of it was exposed before him.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Next stage of cutting up the animal.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The forelegs and the right hind leg (with the testicles) are removed in turn, and then the body is opened.

steps.title: Covering the head with the fat and handing over the innards
steps.stepSummary: The כהן places the פדר fat on top of the cut place on the head. He gives the innards to the כהן who won them so that they can be rinsed.
steps.simpleTranslation: He takes the fats and puts them on top of the place where the head was slaughtered. He takes the innards and gives them to the one who won them, so they can be rinsed.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה describes what is done with the inside parts: the fat goes on the head, and the innards are sent to be rinsed.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פדר is laid on top of the head, right where the animal was slaughtered. The innards are not brought up yet. They are first handed to their assigned כהן to be rinsed, which sets up the next step about how the rinsing is done.

keyTerms.meaning: the place on the neck where it was slaughtered

phrases.english: He took the fats,

phrases.aramaic: וּנְתָנוֹ עַל בֵּית שְׁחִיטַת הָרֹאשׁ מִלְּמַעְלָה.
phrases.english: and placed them on the place of slaughter of the head, on top.
He took the innards,
and gave them to the one who won them, to rinse them.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Uses the opened body from step 3 to deal with the inner parts.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The פדר is placed over the slaughter cut on the head, and the innards are given to their כהן to be rinsed.

steps.title: How the stomach and innards are rinsed
steps.stepSummary: The stomach is rinsed in the rinsing room as much as it needs. The innards are rinsed at least three times on marble tables between the pillars.
steps.simpleTranslation: The stomach is rinsed in the rinsing room, and it is rinsed as much as it needs. The innards are rinsed at least three times, on the marble tables that stand between the pillars.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה finishes this section by explaining where and how much the stomach and the innards are rinsed.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Two different parts get two different rules. The stomach has no fixed number of rinses; it is washed until it is clean, and in a separate rinsing room. The innards have a minimum of three rinses, done on marble tables between the pillars.

keyTerms.meaning: at the least, as a minimum

steps.whatToRemember: Every part of the תמיד is removed in a fixed order and handed to the כהן who won it. The stomach is rinsed until clean in the rinsing room. The innards are rinsed at least three times on the marble tables.
steps.confusionAlert: "Three times" for the innards is a minimum, not an exact number. The stomach has no number at all; it is simply rinsed until it is clean.

phrases.english: And the stomach, they rinse it in the rinsing room.
And they rinse it as much as it needs,
and the innards, they rinse them
three times at the least,

phrases.aramaic: עַל שׁוּלְחָנוֹת שֶׁל שַׁיִשׁ שֶׁבֵּין הָעַמּוּדִים.
phrases.english: on the marble tables that are between the pillars.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Explains how the rinsing mentioned in step 4 is carried out.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The stomach is rinsed fully in the rinsing room. The innards are rinsed at least three times on the marble tables between the pillars.

steps.title: Separating the organs and removing the breast
steps.stepSummary: The כהן separates the lung and the liver's small lobe from the liver without moving them. Then he cuts out the חזה and gives it to the כהן who won it.
steps.simpleTranslation: He took the knife and separated the lung from the liver, and the small finger-shaped lobe from the liver, but did not move any of them from its place. He cut around the breast and gave it to the כהן who won it.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה continues describing the cutting. The כהן loosens the organs from each other and removes the breast.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The organs are separated only from each other, not from the body. Each one stays attached where it is, so it can come off later together with the limb it hangs on. After that, the חזה is cut out and handed to the כהן who won it.

keyTerms.meaning: The small finger-shaped lobe of the liver
The breast (chest piece) of the animal
To the כהן who won that job in the lottery

phrases.english: He took the knife,
and separated the lung from the liver,
and the 'finger' of the liver from the liver,
phrases.notes: The 'finger' is the small lobe that sticks out from the edge of the liver.

phrases.english: and he would not move it from its place.
He would cut around the breast,
and gave it to the one who won it.

steps.triggerLanguage: נָטַל אֶת הַסַּכִּין, וְהִפְרִישׁ אֶת הָרֵיאָה מִן הַכָּבֵד
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the procedure after the innards were given out for rinsing.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The organs are separated from each other but stay in place, and the breast is removed and handed out.

steps.title: Removing the right flank with the liver
steps.stepSummary: The כהן cuts the right flank down to the spine without touching the spine. He stops at the two narrow ribs, and the liver hangs from the right flank.
steps.simpleTranslation: He went up to the right flank and kept cutting downward until the spine, without touching the spine, until he reached the two narrow ribs. He cut it off and gave it to the כהן who won it, with the liver hanging from it.
steps.whatsHappening: The כהן removes the right side of the animal's body as one piece and hands it out.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The spine stays attached to the left side, so the right flank is cut beside it. Because the liver was left in its place in the last step, it now comes off hanging from this flank.

keyTerms.meaning: Flank, the side of the body

phrases.english: He went up to the right flank,
he would cut, going down until the spine,
and he would not touch the spine,

phrases.aramaic: עַד שֶׁמַּגִּיעַ לְבֵין שְׁתֵּי צְלָעוֹת דַּקּוֹת.
phrases.english: until he reached between the two narrow ribs.
He cut it and gave it to the one who won it,
and the liver was hanging from it.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Next limb in the order. It uses the fact that the liver was left in place.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The right flank is cut off without the spine and with the liver hanging from it.

steps.title: Removing the neck piece with the windpipe, heart and lung
steps.stepSummary: The כהן removes the גרה with two narrow ribs on each side. The windpipe, heart and lung hang from it.
steps.simpleTranslation: He came to the neck piece and left two ribs on it from this side and two ribs from that side. He cut it off and gave it to the כהן who won it, with the windpipe, heart and lung hanging from it.
steps.whatsHappening: The כהן removes the neck section, together with some ribs, and hands it out.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Two narrow ribs from each side stay attached to the neck piece. The lung was left in place in step 6, so it comes off here together with the windpipe and heart.

keyTerms.meaning: The neck section of the animal (here translated 'cud')

phrases.english: He came to the cud (neck piece),
he left on it two ribs from here,
and two ribs from there.
He cut it and gave it to the one who won it,
the windpipe, the heart and the lung hanging from it.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Next limb in the order, after the right flank.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The neck piece is removed with two narrow ribs from each side, and the windpipe, heart and lung hang from it.

steps.title: Coming to the left flank and the rib count
steps.stepSummary: The left flank keeps two narrow ribs above and two below, and the right flank was done the same way. So each flank has two ribs at the top and two at the bottom.
steps.simpleTranslation: He came to the left flank and left on it two narrow ribs above and two narrow ribs below, and he did the same with the other flank. It turns out that each flank has two ribs above and two below.
steps.whatsHappening: The כהן comes to the left flank and leaves two narrow ribs on it above and two below. Then the משנה sums up how the narrow ribs end up divided. The next step tells how the left flank is cut off.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Both flanks are treated the same way: two narrow ribs stay at the top and two at the bottom. The word נמצא means 'it turns out' and adds up the result.

keyTerms.meaning: From above (the animal hangs upside down, so this is near the hind legs)
It turns out, the result is

steps.whatToRemember: Each limb comes off with specific organs or ribs still attached. The liver hangs from the right flank, the windpipe, heart and lung hang from the neck piece, and each flank keeps two narrow ribs above and two below.

phrases.english: He came to the left flank,

phrases.aramaic: הִנִּיחַ בָּהּ שְׁתֵּי צְלָעוֹת דַּקּוֹת מִלְּמַעְלָן,
phrases.english: he left on it two narrow ribs above,
and two narrow ribs below,
and he would leave the same on its partner.
phrases.notes: 'Its partner' means the other flank, the right one.

phrases.english: It turns out he leaves two on each above,
and two on each below.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves on to the left flank and sums up how the narrow ribs are divided between both flanks. The flank itself is cut off in step 10.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Each flank keeps two narrow ribs above and two below.

steps.title: The left flank is cut, with the spine and spleen
steps.stepSummary: The כהן cuts the left flank and gives it to the כהן who won it. The spine goes with it, and the spleen hangs from it.
steps.simpleTranslation: He cut the left flank and gave it to the one who won it. The spine was attached to it, and the spleen hung from it.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה continues its step-by-step description. Now the left flank is cut off and handed to its winner.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Step 7 left the spine attached to the body, because the right flank was cut without touching it. Here we learn where the spine ends up: it stays with the left flank. The spleen hangs from that flank too, just as the liver hung from the right flank.

keyTerms.meaning: Won (in the lottery for the right to carry this limb)

phrases.english: He cut it and gave it to the one who won it,
phrases.notes: 'It' means the left flank, which Step 9 just described.

phrases.english: and the spine was with it,
and the spleen hung from it,

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the description of the left flank from Step 9 by telling us how it is cut and what comes with it.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The left flank is cut and given to its winner, with the spine attached and the spleen hanging from it.

steps.title: Why the right flank is called the big one
steps.stepSummary: The left flank was really bigger, because it had the spine. Still, people called the right flank 'the big one' because the liver hung from it.
steps.simpleTranslation: The left flank was actually the bigger one, but people called the right one 'big', because the liver hung from it.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה stops briefly to explain a name. It tells us why the right flank was called 'the big one' even though the left flank was larger.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Because the left flank carried the whole spine, it was the larger piece. But the right flank was called 'big' because the liver hung from it. The name comes from what hangs from it, not from the flank's own size.

keyTerms.meaning: Big or great (here, the name given to one of the flanks)

steps.confusionAlert: Do not mix up the two flanks. The left one was bigger in fact, but the right one was the one called 'big'.

phrases.english: And it was the bigger one,
phrases.notes: This still means the left flank. It is bigger because the spine stayed with it.

phrases.english: but they call the right one 'big'
because the liver hangs from it.

steps.alternativePossibleLabel: שאלה/תשובה (an unspoken question about the name, answered right away)
steps.triggerLanguage: וְהִיא הָיְתָה גְּדוֹלָה אֶלָּא שֶׁל יָמִין קוֹרִין גְּדוֹלָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Explains a name, comparing the left flank from Step 10 with the right flank from Step 7.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The left flank is larger, but the right flank is called 'big' because the liver hangs from it.

steps.title: The haunch is cut, with the tail, part of the liver and the kidneys
steps.stepSummary: The כהן cuts the עוקץ (haunch) and gives it to its winner. The tail, the finger-shaped piece of the liver and the two kidneys go with it.
steps.simpleTranslation: He came to the haunch, cut it, and gave it to the one who won it. The tail, the finger of the liver, and the two kidneys were with it.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה moves on to the next piece, the עוקץ (the haunch at the back of the animal). It tells us what is attached to it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The עוקץ is not carried up by itself. It comes as a set together with the אליה (fat tail), a small piece of the liver and both kidneys, and that whole set goes to one כהן.

keyTerms.meaning: The haunch, the back end of the animal near the tail
The fat tail of the sheep
The 'finger of the liver', a small finger-shaped piece of the liver

phrases.english: He came to the haunch,
cut it, and gave it to the one who won it.
The tail, and the finger of the liver,
and the two kidneys were with it.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves from the flanks to the next piece in order, the עוקץ.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The עוקץ is cut and given to its winner together with the tail, the finger of the liver and both kidneys.

steps.title: The left hind leg is cut last
steps.stepSummary: The כהן takes the left hind leg, cuts it, and gives it to the כהן who won it.
steps.simpleTranslation: He took the left leg, cut it, and gave it to the one who won it.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה describes the last piece to be cut, the left hind leg, which goes to its winner.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This completes the cutting of the animal. Every piece has now been handed to the כהן who won it in the lottery.

phrases.english: He took the left leg,
phrases.notes: This is the upper part of the left back leg that was still left on the animal.

phrases.english: cut it, and gave it to the one who won it.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the order of cutting after the עוקץ with the final piece.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The left hind leg is cut last and given to its winner.

steps.title: All the כהנים stand in a row holding the limbs
steps.stepSummary: Once the cutting is done, all the winning כהנים are standing in a line, each holding his piece of the animal.
steps.simpleTranslation: So all of them were standing in a row, with the limbs in their hands.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה wraps up the whole cutting process with a picture: every winning כהן stands in line holding his piece.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This line adds no new cutting rule. It sums up the result of all the steps before it: each limb now has its own כהן, and they stand in an orderly row, ready for the next stage.

keyTerms.meaning: It turns out / the result was
The limbs (the pieces of the offering)

steps.whatToRemember: The cutting of the תמיד follows a set order, and each piece, along with whatever is attached to it, goes to the כהן who won it. At the end, all the winning כהנים stand in a row, each holding his piece.

phrases.english: So all of them ended up standing in a row,
with the limbs in their hands.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Sums up the result of the whole cutting order that came before.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: When the cutting is finished, all the winning כהנים stand in an orderly line, each holding his limb.
